```{r}
download_and_unzip_data_file <- function(filename, dest_dir, tmp_zip_file) {
  log_info("Downloading and unzipping data file:", filename)
  # Download the bike rentals data file
  download.file(paste0("https://divvy-tripdata.s3.amazonaws.com/", filename, ".zip"), destfile = tmp_zip_file, mode = "wb")
  unzip(tmp_zip_file, exdir = dest_dir)
  file.remove(tmp_zip_file)
}

prepare_data_files <- function() {
  # Create a directory to store the data files
  dest_dir <- "CD705-R/Research/Bike_Rentals/data"
  dir.create(dest_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tmp_zip_file <- paste0(dest_dir, "/bike_rentals.zip")

  root_filenames <- c(
    "202004-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202005-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202006-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202007-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202008-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202009-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202010-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202011-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202012-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202101-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202102-divvy-tripdata"
    , "202103-divvy-tripdata"
    )
  for (filename in root_filenames) {
    csv_file_path <- paste0(dest_dir, "/", filename, ".csv")
    if (file.exists(csv_file_path)) {
      log_info("File already exists:", csv_file_path)
    } else {
      log_info("File does not exist, downloading:", csv_file_path)
      # Download the bike rentals data file
      download_and_unzip_data_file(filename, dest_dir, tmp_zip_file)
    }
  }
}

prepare_data_files()
```

```{r}

# Read the bike rentals data into a data frame
data_files <- list.files("CD705-R/Research/Bike_Rentals/data", pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
bike_rentals <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data_files, read.csv))

# Read the bike rentals data into a data frame
#bike_rentals <- read.csv("CD705-R/Research/Bike_Rentals/data/202004-divvy-tripdata.csv")

bike_rentals$started_at <- as.POSIXct(bike_rentals$started_at, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
bike_rentals$ended_at <- as.POSIXct(bike_rentals$ended_at, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Get a list of days for which we have data
dates <- sort(unique(as.Date(bike_rentals$started_at)))

data_by_day <- data.frame()
for (date in dates) {
  log_info("Processing data for date:", date)
  calendar_date <- as.Date(date)
  day_of_week <- weekdays(calendar_date)
  
  day_data <- subset(bike_rentals, as.Date(started_at) == calendar_date)
  hours <- sort(unique(format(day_data$started_at, "%H")))

  data_by_hour <- data.frame()
  for (hour in hours) {
    hour_data_starts <- subset(day_data, format(started_at, "%H") == hour)
    hour_data_ends <- subset(day_data, format(ended_at, "%H") == hour)
    data_by_day <- rbind(data_by_day, data.frame(date = calendar_date, day_of_week = day_of_week, hour = hour, trips_starting = nrow(hour_data_starts), trips_ending = nrow(hour_data_ends)))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# For each day, calculate the total number of trips starting and ending
daily_summary <- aggregate(cbind(trips_starting, trips_ending) ~ date + day_of_week, data = data_by_day, FUN = sum)

# Plot the total number of trips starting and ending for each day
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(daily_summary, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = trips_starting), color = "blue", linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = trips_ending), color = "red", linetype = "solid") +
  labs(title = "Bike Rentals by Day", x = "Date", y = "Number of Trips") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# For each hour, plot error bars for the number of trips starting and ending
hourly_summary <- aggregate(cbind(trips_starting, trips_ending) ~ hour, data = data_by_day, FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x)))

error_bar_mins <- hourly_summary$trips_starting[, "mean"] - hourly_summary$trips_starting[, "sd"]
error_bar_maxs <- hourly_summary$trips_starting[, "mean"] + hourly_summary$trips_starting[, "sd"]
means <- hourly_summary$trips_starting[, "mean"]

ggplot(hourly_summary, aes(x = hour)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = error_bar_mins, ymax = error_bar_maxs), width = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = means), size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Bike Rentals by Hour", x = "Hour", y = "Number of Trips") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Make a 3d plot of the number of trips starting and ending for each day and hour
library(plotly)
hourly_summary_3d <- aggregate(cbind(trips_starting, trips_ending) ~ date + hour, data = data_by_day, FUN = sum)
fig <- plot_ly(hourly_summary_3d, x = ~date, y = ~hour, z = ~trips_starting, type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers", name = "Trips Starting") %>%
  add_trace(z = ~trips_ending, name = "Trips Ending") %>%
  layout(title = "Bike Rentals by Day and Hour", scene = list(xaxis = list(title = "Date"), yaxis = list(title = "Hour"), zaxis = list(title = "Number of Trips")))
fig
```

```{r}
# Make a 3d plot of the number of trips starting and ending for each day and hour
# Averaged by day of the week

data_by_day_of_week <- aggregate(cbind(trips_starting, trips_ending) ~ day_of_week + hour, data = data_by_day, FUN = mean)

# Order the graph by days of the week
data_by_day_of_week$day_of_week <- factor(data_by_day_of_week$day_of_week, levels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"))

# Order data_by_day_of_week by day_of_week
data_by_day_of_week <- data_by_day_of_week[order(data_by_day_of_week$day_of_week), ]

library(plotly)
fig <- plot_ly(data_by_day_of_week, x = ~day_of_week, y = ~hour, z = ~trips_starting, type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers", name = "Trips Starting") %>%
  layout(title = "Bike Rentals by Day and Hour", scene = list(xaxis = list(title = "Day of Week"), yaxis = list(title = "Hour"), zaxis = list(title = "Number of Trips")))
fig
```
